title: Dockerize Your Application
implemented: Multi-stage, non-root platform images around the original pinned DataScientest application; digest-pinned Alpine backend, health checks and a reviewed dependency patch.
tested: Sequential builds, actual API/database readiness, authenticated browser login, item creation and persistence after reload. Historical main publication succeeded. The Docker fixture used a temporary same-origin Nginx API proxy.
gaps: Publication and authenticated registry pulls for the new Alpine backend are NOT YET TESTED. PR checks do not publish; publication/promotion require a validated push to main. Historical publication evidence is retained.
engineering: I can package an existing application reproducibly and validate the complete UI–API–database path.

title: Deploy the Application in Multiple Environments (Dev & Prod)
implemented: Separate dev/prod namespaces, overlays, host settings, credentials references and a production TLS Secret reference.
tested: Both overlays render; first-pass dev deployment and routing ran locally.
gaps: Production deployment and public TLS are NOT YET TESTED; final hardened dev manifests were not redeployed.
engineering: I separate configuration and release policies while being explicit about shared-node failure domains.

title: Run Tests on the Application
implemented: Upstream tests, PostgreSQL migrations, mypy/Ruff, and metrics/readiness checks run in CI.
tested: 55 upstream tests and 2 platform tests pass; exact CI script passes locally and hosted backend-tests/lint jobs passed at 211199d. New browser login/create/reload smoke passed.
gaps: The complete automated browser E2E suite and OpenAPI-client regeneration are NOT YET TESTED.
engineering: I use automated checks and a focused functional smoke test to catch compatibility regressions.

title: Container Orchestration with Kubernetes
implemented: Deployments, StatefulSet, PVC, Services, ConfigMap, Ingress, namespace policy and resource/security settings.
tested: Historical local dev pods reached 1/1 Ready, PVC Bound, rollouts completed, and frontend/backend/Traefik HTTP routing passed; new manifests render.
gaps: Historical cluster was deleted. Current hardened cluster, policy enforcement, node-readiness screenshot and cloud deployment are NOT YET TESTED.
engineering: I translate application dependencies into orchestrated resources and verify readiness, storage and routing.

title: Automate Deployment (CI/CD Pipeline)
implemented: Tests/build/scan gates, exact-scanned-image publication, dev manifest promotion and manual production sync policy; Argo Application manifests.
tested: Historical main publication/promotion passed. Debian at 211199d failed with 44 HIGH findings. The Alpine fix at 34bf33e passed hosted CI: backend tests/lint, platform validation, exact-image PostgreSQL integration, and both strict image scans. Source security audit also passed. PR publication/promotion intentionally skip; historical Argo comparison failed.
gaps: Successful Argo Synced/Healthy application, public-repo reconciliation and rollback are NOT YET TESTED. The repository became public on 2026-10-23; historical private auth errors do not establish a current public auth failure.
engineering: I design a delivery chain that blocks unsafe releases and keep Git promotion distinct from successful deployment.

title: Create IaC (Infrastructure as Code) Templates
implemented: Terraform Hetzner templates and Ansible preparation/k3s/kubeconfig playbooks, with restricted SSH configuration.
tested: Fresh Terraform fmt/validate and three Ansible syntax checks passed; hosted platform validation passed.
gaps: Terraform plan/apply, actual remote provisioning and server recreation are NOT YET TESTED. No Hetzner API resources were created.
engineering: I express infrastructure as reviewed code and validate it before any billable provisioning.

title: Monitor the Application
implemented: Prometheus/Grafana resources, FastAPI metrics, dashboard, ServiceMonitor and unavailable/5xx alert rules.
tested: All three isolated targets were UP including Grafana; real synthetic request/rate/latency/error metrics rendered; the one-minute unavailable alert fired and cleared after recovery.
gaps: The new ServiceMonitor discovery in Kubernetes, receiver delivery, sustained 5xx alert scenario and durable monitoring recovery are NOT YET TESTED.
engineering: I instrument service behavior and validate alert evaluation rather than equating process uptime with observability.

title: Think About Security (DevSecOps)
implemented: Dependency remediation, strict source/image gates, non-root/read-only controls, dropped capabilities, NetworkPolicies and safe temporary credential cleanup.
tested: Backend progressed from 4 critical/67 high to Debian 0 critical/44 high, then Alpine 0 critical/0 high locally. At 34bf33e, hosted source security and both strict image scans passed. The exact Alpine image passed migrations, login/JWT, authenticated CRUD, health/readiness and metrics under non-root/read-only restrictions. Historical failures are preserved.
gaps: Publication for the Alpine fix is NOT YET TESTED; CI publishes only on a validated main push. Live Kubernetes NetworkPolicy enforcement remains NOT YET TESTED; public HTTPS repository access needs no deploy key. The temporary account SSH key was removed.
engineering: I quantify security improvement, keep failing policy checks enabled, and distinguish configuration from enforcement.

title: Think About Disaster Recovery
implemented: Atomic compressed PostgreSQL backups, recovery/rollback runbooks and off-node snapshot/token guidance.
tested: PG16 backup mode 0600, fresh database restore, same browser-created item ID/title, and failed-dump cleanup passed; previous three-row restore also passed.
gaps: GitOps/deployment rollback, actual k3s snapshot/restore, off-site durability and replacement-server recovery are NOT YET TESTED. The kubectl-to-Docker adapter is documented explicitly.
engineering: I prove recovery with restored data and failure-path checks while stating the boundary of the drill.

title: Documentation
implemented: Architecture/runbooks, exact ten-heading compliance mapping, provenance-backed screenshot index, capture protocol and both ten-minute plans.
tested: Screenshot/source hashes, original-image preservation, asset links and offline presentation gallery are checked before delivery.
gaps: The architecture is a design view; future cloud boxes are not deployment evidence. This is an evidence pack, not an exported PowerPoint deck.
engineering: I make the system reviewable and explain its tested capabilities and remaining risks precisely.
